info.name: Coupons
info.description:
Coupons feature for BarqSolutions.

Base route: /business/{business_id}/branches/{branch_id}/coupons

Date fields:
  usage_start_date / usage_end_date  – window during which the coupon may be redeemed (checked against today)
  reservation_start_date / reservation_end_date – optional constraint: the order's reservation must fall within this range

request.description: General coupon with no reservation constraint. Valid any day between usage_start_date and usage_end_date.

item.name: Create Coupon - percentage multi-use with limit (general)

request.description: No 'code' field – the server generates one automatically.
Coupon only applies when the order's reservation falls within 2026-10-01 → 2026-10-31. Using it on a non-reservation order or a reservation outside that window returns 422.
reservation_end_date is null → any reservation on or after 2026-10-15 qualifies. reservation_start_date alone is enough to trigger the reservation-window check.

item.name: Update Coupon - change code and usage dates
Update Coupon - add reservation window to existing coupon

request.description: Adds a reservation constraint to a coupon that previously had none. From now on the coupon only applies to reservations in November 2026.

item.name: Update Coupon - clear reservation window (set to null)

request.description: Removes the reservation constraint, making the coupon general-purpose again.
Returns discount snapshot. Does NOT record a redemption.

item.name: Check Code - reservation coupon with valid reservation dates

request.description: Reservation (Oct 10–12) is within the coupon's allowed reservation window (Oct 1–31). Expect 200 with 20% discount.

item.name: Check Code - reservation coupon WITHOUT reservation dates (expect 422)

request.description: RESONLY20 requires reservation dates but none are passed. Expect 422: 'This coupon is only valid when applied to a reservation.'

item.name: Check Code - reservation outside coupon window (expect 422)

request.description: Reservation is December; coupon only covers October. Expect 422: 'Coupon is not valid for the selected reservation dates.'
total_price = subtotal minus coupon_discount. coupon_data is cached on the order.

item.name: Create Order - general coupon + item discounts

request.description: discount_amount = sum(discount records) + coupon_discount.

item.name: Create Order - reservation with reservation-scoped coupon (valid window)

request.description: Reservation Oct 10–12 is within RESONLY20's reservation window (Oct 1–31). Expect 201 with 20% discount applied.

item.name: Create Order - reservation-scoped coupon on non-reservation order (expect 422)

request.description: Order has no reservation lines. RESONLY20 requires a reservation. Expect 422: 'This coupon is only valid when applied to a reservation.'

item.name: Create Order - reservation outside coupon's reservation window (expect 422)

request.description: Reservation Dec 20–22 is outside RESONLY20's window (Oct 1–31). Expect 422: 'Coupon is not valid for the selected reservation dates.'
No coupon. discount_amount should be 0 and coupon_data null.

item.name: Create Order - already exhausted single-use coupon (expect 422)

request.description: Run after payment succeeded on a single-use coupon. Expect 422.

item.name: Create Coupon - expired usage dates (can be stored, but will fail at check-code)

request.description: Should return 422: code SAVE10 already exists.
Validation rule: usage_end_date must be after_or_equal usage_start_date.
Validation rule: reservation_end_date must be after_or_equal reservation_start_date.

item.name: 6. Happy-Path Flow – General Coupon (run in order)
Step 4 - Place Order with Coupon + Discount

request.description: discount_amount = KD 5 (item discount) + 15% of subtotal (coupon). total_price = subtotal minus combined discount.

item.name: 7. Happy-Path Flow – Reservation-Scoped Coupon (run in order)
Step 2 - Create Reservation-Scoped Coupon (20% for Oct reservations)

request.description: Coupon may be redeemed Sep–Dec 2026, but only for reservations that fall in October 2026.

item.name: Step 3 - Check Code with October reservation (expect 200 + 20%)
Step 4 - Place Reservation Order with Coupon

request.description: Reservation Oct 15–17 is within the coupon's reservation window. Expect 201 with 20% discount.
